blends.label: Happy-Surprise (Delighted Surprise)
blends.notes: A delighted surprise: high arched brows and wide eyes (AU1+2+5) with dropped jaw (AU26) combined with raised cheeks and smiling lip corners (AU6+12).
keyCues: Upper face shows surprise: arched eyebrows (AU1+2) and widened upper lids (AU5)
Mid/lower face shows happiness: raised cheeks (AU6) and upturned smiling mouth corners (AU12) over a dropped jaw (AU26)

blends.label: Fearful-Surprise (Alarmed Shock / Awe)
blends.notes: Distinguish it from pure fear by the open jaw (AU26 at 0.5), and from pure surprise by the brow pinch (AU4) and horizontal lip stretch (AU20).
keyCues: Fear contributes medial brow pinch (AU4) and horizontal lip stretch (AU20)
Surprise contributes a half-dropped jaw (AU26 at 0.5) and high upper lids (AU5)

blends.label: Angry-Sad (Resentful Grief / Bitter Frustration)
blends.notes: Brow conflict: the AU1 + AU4 pull meets tightened lids (AU7) and narrowed, downward-angled lips (AU15 + AU23).
keyCues: Upper face blends oblique inner-brow lift (AU1) with strong glabella lowering and lid tightening (AU4+7)
Lower face combines narrowed, tightened lip margins (AU23, anger) with downward-pulled mouth corners (AU15, sadness)

blends.label: Disgust-Anger (Plutchik Contempt Dyad / Scorn)
blends.notes: Plutchik's disgust + anger = contempt dyad. Note how this bilateral blend differs from Ekman's unilateral AU14 contempt.
keyCues: Anger drives the lowered brows and narrowed glaring eyelids (AU4 + AU7)
Disgust drives the wrinkled nasal bridge and raised upper lip (AU9 + AU10)

blends.label: Bittersweet (Smile with Sad Brows)
blends.notes: A gentle smile (AU6 at 0.4, AU12 at 0.5) paired with sad oblique inner brows (AU1 at 0.6) and slight corner counter-tension (AU15 at 0.3).
keyCues: Inner eyebrows lift into a wistful oblique angle (AU1, sadness)
Cheeks and mouth corners rise in a soft, restrained smile (AU6 + AU12, happiness)

blends.label: Fearful-Anger (Cornered Hostility)
blends.notes: Combines the wide-eyed horizontal lip stretch of fear (AU1+5+20) with the hard brow furrow, lid squint, and lip tightening of anger (AU4+7+23).
keyCues: Brows are deeply lowered yet inner corners pull up under stress (AU1 + AU4)
Mouth corners stretch horizontally (AU20, fear) while the lip red narrows (AU23, anger)

blends.label: Sad-Disgust (Remorse / Self-Reproach)
blends.notes: Plutchik's remorse dyad: oblique sad brows and downturned mouth corners (AU1+4+15+17) blended with nasal wrinkling and upper-lip lift (AU9+10).
keyCues: Sadness shows in the raised inner brows (AU1) and depressed mouth corners (AU15)
Disgust shows in the wrinkled nose bridge (AU9) and lifted upper lip (AU10)

blends.label: Surprised-Sadness (Disapproval / Shocked Grief)
blends.notes: Plutchik's disapproval dyad: wide surprised upper face (AU1+2+5) with a sad downturned mouth and raised chin (AU15+17).
keyCues: Upper face widens in surprise (AU1+2+5)
Lower face pulls into a pronounced frown with chin elevation (AU15+17, sadness)

blends.label: Happy-Contempt (Smug Amusement)
blends.notes: Warm cheek raise and bilateral smile base (AU6+12) made strongly asymmetrical by unilateral right dimpler tightening (AU14).
keyCues: Cheeks crinkle slightly with genuine pleasure (AU6 + AU12, happiness)
One mouth corner pulls sharply inward and higher via unilateral AU14 (contempt)

blends.label: Fearful-Disgust (Revulsion / Horror)
blends.notes: Wide eyes, flattened brows, and stretched lips (fear) combined with nasal wrinkling and upper-lip sneer (disgust).
keyCues: Wide upper lids (AU5) and horizontal lip pull (AU20) signal fear
Wrinkled nose bridge (AU9) and raised upper lip (AU10) signal disgust

blends.label: Happy-Surprise (Moderate Intensity)
keyCues: Moderate brow arch and lid widening (surprise) with soft Duchenne smile (happiness)

blends.label: Angry-Sad (Moderate Intensity)
keyCues: Subtle oblique brow furrow (AU1+4) with tightened, downturned lips (AU15+23)

maskedFlashes.label: Anger Flash Masked by Social Smile (150 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: A brief 150 ms flash of anger (AU4+5+7+23) immediately covered by a held social smile (AU12 alone).

maskedFlashes.label: Fear Flash Masked by Social Smile (150 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: A 150 ms flash of fear (pinched brows AU1+2+4, wide eyes AU5, stretched lips AU20) quickly masked by a polite smile (AU12).

maskedFlashes.label: Disgust Flash Masked by Social Smile (140 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: Nose wrinkling and upper-lip elevation (AU9+10) flash for 140 ms before being overridden by AU12.

maskedFlashes.label: Sadness Flash Masked by Social Smile (160 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: Oblique inner brows and downturned lip corners (AU1+4+15) appear briefly before a social smile covers them.

maskedFlashes.label: Contempt Flash Masked by Social Smile (150 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: A unilateral right dimpler smirk (AU14) flashes before turning into a symmetrical posed smile (AU12).

maskedFlashes.label: Surprise Flash Masked by Controlled Neutral (130 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: A sudden flash of surprise (AU1+2+5+26) quickly clamped back to a poker-faced neutral.

maskedFlashes.label: Anger Flash Masked by Social Smile (100 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: Rapid 100 ms flash of anger immediately masked by a social smile.

maskedFlashes.label: Fear Flash Masked by Social Smile (100 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: Rapid 100 ms flash of fear immediately covered by an AU12 social smile.

maskedFlashes.label: Disgust Flash Masked by Social Smile (100 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: Rapid 100 ms flash of disgust covered by a posed smile.

maskedFlashes.label: Sadness Flash Masked by Social Smile (100 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: Rapid 100 ms flash of sadness masked by an AU12 smile.

maskedFlashes.label: Left Contempt Flash Masked by Social Smile (120 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: Left unilateral AU14 contempt flash covered by a symmetrical social smile.

maskedFlashes.label: Suppressed Amusement Masked by Stoic Neutral (130 ms)
maskedFlashes.explanation: A brief Duchenne smile (AU6+12) quickly suppressed into a serious expression.

upperFaceLeaks.label: Upper-Face Fear Leak Under Social Smile (120 ms)
upperFaceLeaks.explanation: While the mouth holds a social smile (AU12), the upper face briefly leaks fear (AU1+2+4+5) for 120 ms.

upperFaceLeaks.label: Upper-Face Anger Leak Under Social Smile (120 ms)
upperFaceLeaks.explanation: While the mouth holds a polite smile (AU12), the brows lower and lids glare (AU4+5+7) for 120 ms.

upperFaceLeaks.label: Upper-Face Sadness Leak Under Social Smile (130 ms)
upperFaceLeaks.explanation: Under a steady AU12 smile, the inner eyebrows pull up and together into an oblique sadness triangle (AU1+4).

upperFaceLeaks.label: Upper-Face Surprise Leak Under Social Smile (120 ms)
upperFaceLeaks.explanation: While maintaining a social smile, the eyebrows arch high and the upper lids widen (AU1+2+5).

upperFaceLeaks.label: Upper-Nasal Disgust Leak Under Social Smile (130 ms)
upperFaceLeaks.explanation: Nasal bridge wrinkling (AU9) and upper-lip sneer (AU10) briefly leak through an ongoing social smile.

upperFaceLeaks.label: Unilateral Contempt Spike Under Social Smile (140 ms)
upperFaceLeaks.explanation: A mild polite smile briefly shifts into a sharp unilateral right dimpler tightening (AU14).

smileTiming.label: Genuine Duchenne Smile (Smooth 500 ms Onset/Offset + AU6)
smileTiming.explanation: Genuine smiles build smoothly over ~500 ms, engage AU6 (cheek raise + crow's feet), and fade gradually.

smileTiming.label: Posed Social Smile (Abrupt 80 ms Step Onset + AU12 Only)
smileTiming.explanation: Posed social smiles snap on in ~80 ms, lack AU6 cheek elevation, hold rigidly, and drop off abruptly.

smileTiming.label: Genuine Warm Smile (Gradual Onset & Slow Fade + AU6)
smileTiming.explanation: Smooth 550 ms onset and 650 ms offset with synchronized AU6 cheek raise and AU12 lip corner pull.

smileTiming.label: Posed Polite Smile (Fast Onset & Instant Drop-off)
smileTiming.explanation: Appears in 80 ms without eye involvement (AU12 only) and vanishes in 70 ms.
